correctness.rationale: A fixed point of a simplicial vertex permutation has constant barycentric coefficients on each orbit. Replacing each admissible vertex orbit by its barycenter yields an injective PL parameterization, with orbit collections permitted precisely when their union contains no three consecutive path indices. For both odd and even n, the central two selected outward orbits create forbidden pair {1,2}; elsewhere forbidden consecutive triples give exactly E_m. The augmented face-poset matching pairs vertex-2-absent faces by toggling 1; vertex-2-present faces identify with shifted E_(m−2). Acyclicity follows because matched edges never change membership of 2 and every unmatched crossing points monotonically downward; induction gives no cycles within each fiber. The residual augmented critical face {2,4,...,m} occurs only for even m, with the empty face paired; removing its matched pair gives one 0-cell and at most one top cell, yielding contractibility or sphere (including S^0 at m=2). Independently enumerated E_m faces and reduced Euler characteristics for m=1..10; inspected complete source acyclic-Morse verifier, whose finite checks cannot replace all-m induction.
residual_risks: A previously unindexed geometric-fixed-path classification could exist; statement is PL homeomorphism to E_m but only homotopy equivalence to a sphere, not PL sphere homeomorphism; finite mod-2 homology alone insufficient.
